description: This Java source file defines the class 'DittoMessageMapper', an implementation of a message mapper for the Ditto Protocol within the Eclipse Ditto project. It handles converting between external messages and internal protocol representations, focusing on JSON serialization/deserialization and header management. The class is part of the package 'org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.mapping'.

classes.name: DittoMessageMapper
classes.description: Implements message mapping for the Ditto Protocol, converting between external messages and internal adaptable representations. Handles JSON serialization/deserialization, header management, and supports error and response detection.

methods.name: map (ExternalMessage)
methods.description: Converts an ExternalMessage into a list of Adaptable objects by extracting its payload, parsing JSON, and merging headers.

methods.name: map (Adaptable)
methods.description: Converts an Adaptable object into a list of ExternalMessage objects, serializing the payload to JSON, setting appropriate headers, and handling message types.

methods.name: getDefaultOptions
methods.description: Returns the default JSON options used for message mapping.
